# Third-party code (host tests only)

Copied unmodified from the ESP-IDF v5.5.5 tree (`~/esp/esp-idf`) so host tests build offline
and without `IDF_PATH`. Never linked into firmware.

| Directory | Source in ESP-IDF | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `unity/` | `components/unity/unity/src` | Unity 2.6.0 | MIT (`unity/LICENSE.txt`) |
| `cjson/` | `components/json/cJSON` | cJSON 1.7.19 | MIT (`cjson/LICENSE`) |
